modmenu.summaryTranslation.chunkstorageo: Suffereth Voxy's world import to read the .cso region files written by Chunk Storage Optimizer.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.chunkstor: With Voxy installed, /voxy import world and /voxy import current do also read the .cso region files written by Chunk Storage Optimizer, not merely the vanilla .mca ones. It doth nothing without Voxy installed.
